services.name: Private Barrier Island Kayak Tour
services.desc: >Paddle with us on our 3 hour Private Barrier Island Tour which offers a unique opportunity for shelling, swimming, and sunbathing on a beach that is accessible only by boat. We time this tour to catch the falling tide out to the island and the rising tide back in for an easier paddle. Our experienced guides will be there every step of the way for the best experience possible. During this kayak tour you will: > Kayak through the pristine marsh channels to Waites Island, one of the few undeveloped barrier islands on the east coast of South Carolina > Experience what is only accessible to Waties Island Tour

Our experience as the original kayak outfit in North Myrtle Beach makes our tours hard to beat! Our adventure locations include The Waccamaw River, Waties Island, and Cherry Grove Marsh.
